restoration_note: Teaching describes the Father's two-stage cosmic surgery: he pours the three strongholds (Water of Error, Darkness, Fire) down from heaven onto the earth, then draws them back upward, so the buried kindred-elements in the natural mind are pulled out by correspondence-of-likeness. Most gaps were editor's letter-restorations within recoverable formulas (ⲙⲁⲛⲭⲓⲟⲟⲣⲉ 'strongholds,' ⲁϥⲱⲟⲩⲟ 'he poured,' ⲁⲩⲧⲟⲩⲃⲟ 'they purified,' ⲁⲡⲓⲧⲛⲉ 'downward'); these were confirmed. Several medium lacunae were restorable from the recurrent purification-formula (ⲡⲙⲁⲩ ⲡⲥⲁⲣⲙⲉ 'water of Error,' ⲙⲛⲛⲥⲱⲥ 'afterwards,' ⲁⲡⲙⲁ 'to the place'). Three large lacunae (est_chars 14-30, especially the 'rubbed off' segments at {28} and {52}) and the broken triple-gap at lines 17 ({13}-{15}) were left unrestorable: too little surviving anchor for honest fill.
